input.free_text_description: This system is an user management platform that serves User, Candidate roles. It manages core business objects including transaction, fund transfer request, fund transfer, sequence. The platform provides capabilities for account application, feign client error decoder, global exception handler. The system includes access control and identity verification to protect resources and manage sessions. Secondary concerns include distributed transactions functionality.

user_stories.story: As a User, I want to securely sign in to the system, so that I can access my personalized resources.
As a User, I want to create and manage transaction records, so that I can track and organize transaction data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage fund transfer request records, so that I can track and organize fund transfer request data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage fund transfer records, so that I can track and organize fund transfer data effectively.
As a User, I want to create and manage sequence records, so that I can track and organize sequence data effectively.
